name: bmad-deep-recon
description: Perform a bounded, evidence-led investigation of an unfamiliar RAG subsystem or deployment issue. Use when asked to trace behavior or diagnose a complex problem.
---

# Deep reconnaissance

Define the question and stop condition. Trace the relevant code and configuration
from entry point to observable outcome, checking tests and runtime evidence when
available. Separate confirmed root causes from hypotheses. Avoid broad audits
or unrelated changes; conclude with evidence, impact, and the next smallest step.
